correctness.rationale: All nonzero structural weights and a permutation support force monomial isomorphisms. On each ordered cycle scaling changes P by a (2^ell-1)th power; origin rotations act by squaring. Burnside counts cycle types, independent multiplicities give the Euler product; stabilizer rotations and scaling kernels yield exact automorphism order. Recursion x_{sigma(i)}=a_i x_i^2 proves the element-idempotent formula; order of 2 mod odd prime divisor gives sharp minimal dimension. Correctness includes q=2, char=2 and ell=1 boundaries. Packaged checker independently verifies small finite fields/dimensions and automorphism/idempotent counts, but finite data are not an all-n proof.

value.rationale: The weighted-permutation locus is a natural, infinite-dimensional family of perfect evolution algebras; its scalar parameters survive over finite fields even though algebraically closed classifications normalize them away. The classification resolves full isomorphism counts at every size, complete symmetry orders and element-idempotent statistics, and gives an exact field-dependent obstruction and minimum dimension for idempotent-free members. This is structural and not a mere isolated finite count or renaming.
